params.name: menu
params.description: Menu number, or a MenuRef (reference) created with Create menu.

sentinelValues.meaning: the last item added to the menu
all items of the menu at once (enable/disable in bulk)

params.name: process
params.description: If omitted, applies to the menu bar of the current process. Ignored if menu is a MenuRef.

constraints: If menuItem designates a hierarchical submenu, all items of that submenu (and any of its own submenus) are disabled too.
Also works with a menu bar created with Create menu and installed with SET MENU BAR.
